name: Sankha Ranjan Patra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sankha Ranjan Patra is a poet and fiction writer from West Bengal whose writing spans English, Bengali and Hindi. His English poetry collections include Muse and Mute; his other books include All About Love and the Bengali poetry collection Borsha. Publisher and journal biographies place poetry at the centre of a practice that also extends into fiction and anthology contributions.

‘Let It Happen’ gives emotional absence the scale of a cosmic event. Repeated invitations to let the world collapse lead through rocks, oceans and empty space to the possibility of a loved one returning as a comet. The final question leaves a small opening for reunion within the poem’s language of destruction.
